messages:
deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY deploy scheduled by @maria — cfg-5421. Change window 2025-02-10 04:30 UTC (canary). Diff summary: routing.bias -> prefer-region, per_tenant_rate_limit: 1.2qps -> 1.0qps, inference_timeout: 8s -> 5s, batching.max_tokens: 2048 -> 1024, batching.max_batch_size: 64 -> 32. Targets: hosted-stable + dedicated-pool-eu. Canary 5% for 15m (adjustable). Auto-rollback on >1.5x error OR p95 > 2x baseline. Deploy run: https://deploy.redwood.internal/runs/6789
maria: tagging dashboards and alerts. I'll be watching p50/p95/error-rate. @ops-oncall are you able to be primary for this window?
ops-oncall: oncall here, will be available. Set playbook to playbooks/config-rollback. Suggest alert thresholds: error-rate > 0.8% OR p95 > 1200ms sustained 5m -> auto rollback. I'm at desk for the window. :white_check_mark:
sam: note — kvcache TTLs unchanged but routing bias increase could raise cross-region tails. Recommend gradual ramp: 5% x 20m -> 25% x 10m before full, to catch tails.
julian: customers sensitive to tail latency; prefer short hold at 25% before full. Rollback command (manual):
```
deployctl config revert --id cfg-5421 --reason "auto-rollback" --force
```
liz: quick QA scan — idle TTLs untouched, LB healthchecks fine. LGTM from QA side.
maria: updating canary plan: 5% x 20m, then 25% x 10m -> full. Also adding manual tenant pin: route high-tier tenants to pinned v2 if latency > 1.2s.
release-coordinator: added to calendar and draft release note: "tweaked routing bias and batching limits to reduce cost and p50; lowered per-tenant qps". Will publish to #release-notes after stable.
deploy-bot: Canary started (cfg-5421) — 5% traffic -> hosted-stable. Monitoring streams: https://obs.redwood.internal/dashboards/cfg-5421
maria: p95 ~1.1x baseline, error-rate flat. continuing watch.
ops-oncall: alert: p95 spike to 1.8x at ~10m mark. Error-rate still <0.5% but tail increased. Holding canary and investigating logs. tagging @sam @julian :mag:
sam: pulling logs — looks like eu-east queueing increased after batch-size reduction + per-tenant qps cutting throughput. Quick log snippet: 
```
[eu-east] queue_delay_ms: 420 -> 980
batch_size_avg: 12 -> 6
```
julian: that matches. Routing.bias to prefer-region is increasing cross-region hop probability for some tenants. Given p95 bump, recommending rollback of routing.bias + batching.max_tokens. If no recovery in 3m, we should revert.
maria: agree. If not back to baseline in 3m, initiate rollback. :warning:
ops-oncall: initiating manual rollback now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for cfg-5421 -> revert to cfg-5398 (previous config). Rollback started at 1719183300. Command executed: `deployctl config revert --id cfg-5421` — monitoring rollback progress.
maria: rollback confirmed complete, p95/p50 back to baseline. Closing canary. We'll rework change: smaller batch token reduction + region-aware ramp before next attempt. Thanks all.
ops-oncall: follow-up: add staging sim for batch-size vs per-tenant qps to catch this. I'll create a ticket. :memo:
release-coordinator: release notes updated, marked as rolled back and blocked for recut. Will re-schedule after additional validation.
